device.manufacturer: Klipper / Moonraker project (Arksine, Kevin O'Connor & community)
device.name: Moonraker API (Klipper web API server)
device.notes:
Moonraker is the API server that fronts Klipper 3D-printer firmware; Fluidd, Mainsail and KlipperScreen are its clients. Any Klipper-based printer running Moonraker exposes this, so a printer device spec can cite this file. GPLv3, fully local, no cloud.
TRANSPORTS (one server): HTTP REST ("REST-ish", dynamically registered endpoints) and JSON-RPC 2.0 over a WebSocket at /websocket (ws://host:port/websocket). Default port 7125; default ssl_port 7130; default host 0.0.0.0. HTTP endpoints map to JSON-RPC method names (dotted namespaces). HTTP success returns {"result": <data>}; JSON-RPC returns the matching id + result/error.
REPRESENTATIVE METHODS/ENDPOINTS: printer.info (klippy host info), server.info (server + klippy state), printer.objects.query (live object status), server.files.metadata (G-code metadata), printer.gcode.script (run a G-code line), printer.print.start / printer.print.pause / .resume / .cancel.
AUTH: the [authorization] block — trusted_clients (IPs/CIDRs/domains given full API access) plus cors_domains; both empty by default (so a fresh install trusts only localhost until configured).
